name: Brig Gen Charles E. Yeager Award (full-size medal body)
size_basis: Body width 1.375 in = the standard ribbon width for this size (1 3/8 in full, 5/8 in miniature; DoDM 1348.33 as relayed by the coordination chat, not verified locally); proportions from the McChord rasters (disc = ribbon width); CAPR 39-3 gives no medal dimensions. Height is the constructed body plus suspension ring.

ribbon_ref.note: medal body only; the ribbon asset supplies the stripes and devices. ribbon_attach is where the ribbon meets the suspension loop.

source: Designed and measured from the Vanguard photograph aeroeducation.jpeg (reference only): disc, rim, lettering, emblem, bail and ring are parametric shapes in inches, the same model as the miniature drawn at 2.2x (design/yeager.js). Previously constructed from the McChord rasters.

fit.metric: same model as the miniature body, which is gated against the photograph (silhouette IoU, landmarks within 0.02 in, edge recall)
fit.note: Shape-built art at 2.2x, upright; ring and bail are cut open at the box top where the box cuts them.

measured.photo: aeroeducation.jpeg (Vanguard photograph, 600 x 600 px, reference only)

frame.note: body width 0.625 in (the spec width) sets the scale; every length below is inches in the medal frame (origin = disc centre, +y down, UPRIGHT: the photograph is rotated by the measured hang angle into this frame)

measured.hang_angle_note: measured from the bail axis against the disc centre in the photograph (frame.js); the drawing hangs upright (bail and disc axis vertical)
not_measurable: IDENTITY: the Vanguard photograph aeroeducation.jpeg is the CAP Aerospace Education (Air Force Auxiliary / Aerospace Education) miniature medal, NOT the Brig Gen Charles E. Yeager Award; assets/medals-work/NO_REFERENCE.md records that Vanguard sells only a RIBBON for the Yeager award, and no Yeager medal photograph exists in the repository (photomap.json has no Yeager entry; the composite Civil_Air_Patrol_Awards_and_Decorations.jpg is a uniform photograph without a legible medal). This body is therefore the Aerospace Education medal, modelled because it is the only measurable CAP medal body for this asset id; whether the real Yeager medal looks like this is UNCONFIRMED.
The cast silver surface: soft shading inside the emblem triangle and legs and the engraving grain are not drawn (flat tones).

The lamp is read from a ~1 px wide silhouette: the small stub above the saucer and the notch at the right end of the crossbar are approximate; the thin light slit between the A and the spout is not drawn (the figure parts simply do not touch).
Suspension ring: seen as three fine parallel wires in the photograph; drawn as one circle of the combined width.
